guesses.question: You wrote that Glass Harbour and Second Lamp both came to you in the winter of 2021, during your bakery night shifts. Is that when the two records came to you, with one slowing your walk home and the other keeping you company?

quotes.quote: in the winter of 2021, when I worked night shifts at a bakery in Leeds
during a night shift that same winter

what_it_did.quote: It made me slow down on that walk instead of rushing to bed.
That song kept me company until the ovens were done.
